PUST

180minutes
44solder joints
difficulty

An AirGradient ONE-compatible indoor air monitor

Heat the pad and the pin together for two seconds. Feed solder into the joint, not onto the iron. Take the solder away first, then the iron.

Strip 3 mm, twist the strands, and tin the end before you solder it to a pad.

Unplug USB and disconnect any battery before you solder or change a wire. Work on a surface that does not burn, and wash your hands after handling solder.

28PUST-WIRE-1

Before you switch it on

  1. Look. Every joint is a shiny cone. No solder touches a neighbouring pad. No stray strands of wire.
  2. These must not beep. Set the multimeter to continuity and probe each pair. A beep means a short: find it before you plug in.
    5VGND3V3GND
  3. These must beep. Probe the two ends of every connection.
    5VController 5V · CO2 sensor G+ · Particle sensor VCC
    GNDController GND · CO2 sensor G0 · Particle sensor GND · Display GND · Temp/RH GND · VOC/NOx GND · Button 2
    3V3Controller 3V3 · Display VCC · Temp/RH VIN · VOC/NOx VIN
    I2C_SDAController 7 · Display SDA · Temp/RH SDA · VOC/NOx SDA
    I2C_SCLController 6 · Display SCL · Temp/RH SCL · VOC/NOx SCL
    S8_RXCO2 sensor UART_TxD · Controller 0
    S8_TXController 1 · CO2 sensor UART_RxD
    PMS_RXParticle sensor TX · Controller 20
    PMS_TXController 21 · Particle sensor RX
    BUTTONController 9 · Button 1
  4. Plug in. Nothing gets warm, nothing smells. If something does, unplug at once and go back to step 2.
  5. Flash the bring-up test. It reports every part it can find before you load the real firmware.pio run -e bringup -t upload && pio device monitor
29PUST-WIRE-1

Pust is built

Pust measures CO2, particulate matter, temperature, humidity and VOC/NOx indices in a room and shows them on a small OLED. It uses the same sensors and the same ESP32-C3 pin map as the AirGradient ONE (I-9PSL), so it runs AirGradient's own open-source firmware unmodified, with local and cloud logging. Hand-wired from modules into a printed, ventilated case.
